description: A React component implementing a task management dashboard with features like task listing, creation, editing, deletion, optimistic updates, error handling, and session management.

methods.name: tempId
methods.description: Generates a temporary unique ID for optimistic task creation.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the list of tasks from the API, handles loading state and errors.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Handles creation of a new task with optimistic UI update and error recovery.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Handles updating a task with optimistic UI, concurrency checks, and error handling.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Handles deletion of a task with optimistic UI and error recovery.
